templates.title: Homelable
templates.name: homelable
templates.description: Homelable 3.5.1 is a self-hosted homelab diagram with live status monitoring.

env.name: BACKEND_UPSTREAM
env.label: BACKEND_UPSTREAM
env.description: Nginx upstream for the API. The backend service name must stay backend.

env.name: SQLITE_PATH
env.label: SQLITE_PATH
env.description: SQLite database path inside the data volume.

env.name: CORS_ORIGINS
env.label: CORS_ORIGINS
env.description: Browser origins allowed to call the API.

env.name: AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH
env.label: AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH
env.description: bcrypt hash of the local login password. Dollar signs are escaped in the compose file.

env.name: SCANNER_RANGES
env.label: SCANNER_RANGES
env.description: JSON array of CIDR ranges to scan. Empty until you set your LAN.
